Game Overview

In Defend the Castle, the core idea is straightforward: fortify your kingdom in Defend the Castle. Strategically build and upgrade defenses with gold and wood to resist relentless enemy waves. Deploy cunning tactics with cannons and archers. Can you protect the King and let your stronghold stand the test of time?

How to Play

Playing Defend the Castle comes down to a simple loop. Fortify your kingdom in Defend the Castle! Strategically build and upgrade defenses with gold and wood to resist relentless enemy waves. Deploy cunning tactics with cannons and archers. Can you protect the King and let your stronghold stand the test of time?
